intent.description: Validation styling on the search field. Single column only; the multi-column field does not take it.

keepSearchOnSelect.description: For a multi-select, leaves the typed text in place after a selection instead of clearing it.

label.description: The search field's label and placeholder.

multiple.description: If `true`, `value` must be an array and the menu will support multiple selections.

onChange.description: Fired on every selection change with the whole value. details.option is the one that just changed. Signature: function(event: SyntheticEvent, value: T | T[], reason: AutocompleteChangeReason, details?: AutocompleteChangeDetails<T>) => void
onChange.type: AutocompleteSingleColumnOnChange<T, Multiple, DisableClearable, FreeSolo> | AutocompleteMultiColumnOnChange<T, Multiple, DisableClearable, FreeSolo>

options.description: The options, or an array of named columns each with their own options.

value.description: The selection. An array when multiple, and a record keyed by column name when there is more than one column.
value.type: string | Exclusive<AutocompleteOptionBasic, AutocompleteOptionComponent> | Exclusive<AutocompleteOptionComponent, AutocompleteOptionBasic> | Record<string | number | symbol, AutocompleteValue<T, Multiple, DisableClearable, FreeSolo>> | (T | AutocompleteFreeSoloValueMapping<FreeSolo>)[] | AutocompleteOptionBasic & { component?: undefined; } | AutocompleteOptionComponent & { details?: undefined; icon?: undefined; count?: undefined; sdsIconProps?: undefined; }

search.description: Shows the search field. Without it the input is hidden and disabled, and the list must be opened through open.

onClick.description: Fired when the component would like to open.

onClickAway.description: Fired when the component would like to close, including on Escape and on a click outside.

InputBaseProps.description: Props for the search field. This is the way in: SDS supplies renderInput itself.

renderInput.description: (params: AutocompleteRenderInputParams) => ReactNode. Replaces the whole input, losing the search and clear buttons SDS puts there, so prefer InputBaseProps. On a multi-column Autocomplete it reaches the hidden per-column inputs rather than the trigger.

PopperBaseProps.description: Props for the popper holding the columns. Multi-column only; a single column uses MUI's own popper.

PopperComponent.description: Replaces that popper outright. Multi-column only.

PopperPlacement.description: Where the columns are placed. Multi-column only.

ClickAwayListenerProps.description: Props for the MUI ClickAwayListener that closes the columns. Multi-column only.

disableCloseOnSelect.description: If `true`, the popup won't close when a value is selected.

blurOnSelect.description:
Control if the input should be blurred when an option is selected:

- `false` the input is not blurred.
- `true` the input is always blurred.
- `touch` the input is blurred after a touch event.
- `mouse` the input is blurred after a mouse event.

clearOnBlur.description:
If `true`, the input's text is cleared on blur if no value is selected.

Set it to `true` if you want to help the user enter a new value.
Set it to `false` if you want to help the user resume their search.

noOptionsText.description:
Text to display when there are no options.

For localization purposes, you can use the provided [translations](https://mui.com/material-ui/guides/localization/).

loading.description:
If `true`, the component is in a loading state.
This shows the `loadingText` in place of suggestions (only if there are no suggestions to show, for example `options` are empty).
